Surfaced September 19, 2026 at 22:22 PDT alongside the Roi Et URLQuery/paste match.

The original review reported a Codex web-search result for https://friendpaste.com/qm6K3qnDsZF0nB8fkptHB titled NSO RoiEt Values. Its first two year/value pairs matched the Roi Et answer table (the follow-up Google query used 46308 and 32212). The search result displayed a relative date of six months earlier, approximately March; 

Related existing library finding #61 by Gary covers Friendpaste as a broader candidate venue and its reported downtime. This entry adds the specific Roi Et page and matching-value observation; it does not independently validate or claim causation for the downtime.

Follow-up: recover original search-tool logs or an archived page, verify the content and timestamp, and compare it with the March 11 table. Government relevance is the Thai public-statistics task. No cyberattack or AI-company attribution is established.
data.summary: A search result for a Friendpaste page titled “NSO RoiEt Values” matched two year/value pairs from the March 11 Roi Et answer table.
